I'm glad to hear it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:AF03}{spk:0080}{n}But it was all a vile trap laid by Sierra and her kind...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B003}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}And yet I...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B103}{spk:0080}{n}I turned my own rage on others...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B203}{spk:0080}{n}A doctor, of all people, calmly taking the lives of one sinner after another...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B303}{spk:0080}{n}Even if Liza's death set it off, to think such madness lay hidden in me that I could not hold back my own rage...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B403}{spk:0080}{n}I can no longer trust myself...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Dian, everyone makes mistakes...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Can't you simply strive on from here with a righteous heart?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B503}{spk:0080}{n}...But the madness may not have left my heart.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B603}{spk:0080}{n}...Ever since Liza was gone, I have not been myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B703}{spk:0080}{n}Only now do I understand how precious and needed she was. Liza always guided me down the right path...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B803}{spk:0080}{n}But now that she is gone, what am I to do?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Dian... I don't know what to say to you, but please believe in yourself and live on.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:B903}{spk:0080}{n}...I understand. I will try... Only... only give me a little more time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:BA03}{spk:0080}{n}Time to judge whether I am truly worthy of being a hero...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...All right. I'll come to see you again, then. I know it's hard, but hang in there.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:BB03}{spk:0080}{n}...Forgive me. Thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Dian, I've come to ask you once more to be my hero.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}No, I... am a man who could not even protect the one he loved most... {fb:0180}{n}{e0:CD03}{spk:0080}{n}...This ring is from those days, when I had Liza, and hope, and a heart full of dreams...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
